title: SAGE-QA: Semantic-Aware, Grounded Evaluation for Closed-Context Question Answering on SQuAD 2.0
abstract: arXiv:2611.16300v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Closed-context question answering (QA) requires a system to generate an answer strictly supported by a supplied passage, or to abstain when the passage lacks adequate evidence. SQuAD 2.0 is a widely used benchmark for this setting, scored by Exact Match (EM) i.e., character-level agreement with human reference spans after lexical normalization. For generative large language models (LLMs), however, an EM failure may reflect a valid paraphrase or an alternative passage-supported answer rather than a hallucination. The best prior leaderboard EM is approximately 91%, but evaluating generative models requires separating lexical divergence from factual error. translated_abstract: 封闭上下文问答要求系统生成严格由所提供文段支持的答案，或者在文段缺乏充分证据时选择拒答。SQuAD 2.0是这一场景下广泛使用的基准，其评分采用精确匹配（EM），即经过词汇规范化后与人工参考答案片段在字符级别上的一致性。然而，对于生成式大语言模型而言，EM评分失败可能反映的是有效的同义改写或另一个由文段支持的答案，而非幻觉。此前排行榜上的最佳EM成绩约为91%，但评估生成式模型需要将词汇差异与事实错误区分开来。我们提出了SAGE-QA（语义感知、有据可依的问答评估），这是一个多层评估框架，结合了基于参考答案的语义等价评分（SES）和基于文段的重新验证评分（RVS）。在固定的10,000个SQuAD 2.0验证样本集上，我们计算EM和……
tldr: SAGE-QA是一个多层评估框架，通过结合基于参考答案的语义等价评分（SES）和基于文段的重新验证评分（RVS），解决了传统精确匹配指标在评估生成式大语言模型封闭上下文问答时无法区分词汇差异与事实错误的问题。
en_tdlr: SAGE-QA is a multi-tiered evaluation framework that combines reference-based Semantic Equivalence Scoring (SES) and passage-based Re-Validation Scoring (RVS) to address the limitation of Exact Match metrics in distinguishing valid paraphrases from hallucinations when evaluating generative LLMs on closed-context question answering.
